name: WayriCAD Manufacturing Readiness Manager
description: Audit fabricator capabilities and gate deterministic KiCad manufacturing releases.
description_full: Includes a dedicated DFM / DFA Studio action with process-scoped vendor presets, persistent checklists, optional saved-change background checks, native DRC findings linked to saved board geometry, and HTML/PDF evidence. The existing manufacturing release gates and archive workflow remain available. Vendor coverage is partial; unknown and manual checks do not establish fabrication or assembly acceptance.
